Flau'jae Johnson and the LSU Tigers will play the Duke Blue Devils on Friday at the NCAA tournament, here's how to watch. (Ella Hall/NCAA Photos via Getty Images) (Ella Hall via Getty Images) Liz Kocan Contributing Writer Fri, March 27, 2026 at 4:46 PM UTC · 2 min read No. 2 LSU and No. 3 Duke have both reached the Sweet 16 in the 2026 March Madness tournament. This won't be the teams' first meeting of the year; LSU beat Duke of 93-77 back in early December. The elite teams will play at the Golden 1 Center in Sacramento, CA this Friday, March 27 at 10 p.m. ET, the final game in a quadruple-header on ESPN that starts at 2:30 pm.
